defects_found_by_these_runs: PR_SET_PDEATHSIG followed the request thread and killed the peer at once
A first click re-created the rows, so a double click did nothing
A delete could act on a folder other than the one shown after a failed navigation
A finished refresh reset the selection to the first row, so Copy took another item
aiortc: a FORWARD-TSN discards received fragments of a large reliable message, which stops the ordered channel for good
aiortc: after a timeout the SCTP window stays at one packet under a paced sender
The rate controller collapsed in several different ways, each seen on a real path and not in the first model
open: The ordered channel stopped in 2 of 44 uploads of 80 MiB through TURN after the FORWARD-TSN fix, then in 0 of 32 with no change of cause in between. Stream sequence stuck, fragments held, cumulative TSN advancing. Cause not found. A watchdog replaces the connection and restarts the file.
No fast path yet, so a fast LAN is not filled.
A download takes less of a narrow path than an upload (0.9-1.4 against 1.6-1.7 of 2 Mbit/s).
On 2 Mbit/s a transfer costs the console about 10-20 ms.
